throughline: Markets hit fresh records on cooling CPI while the AI-power buildout's capital discipline spreads from turbines into long-duration storage (hyperscalers now bankrolling LDES) and into hard grid-reliability rules (FERC/NERC mandating data-center ride-through after a 3.8GW Virginia trip), even as geopolitical friction sharpens everywhere — Ukraine strikes the Russian navy directly, North Korea tests a second missile in a week, Congress fast-tracks 100% tariffs on Russian-oil buyers — and China's leasehold crisis and the Philippines' new China-threat/impeachment drama both expose stress sitting just beneath the calm tape
explainers: ride-through reliability requirements as the demand-side mirror of generator ride-through rules
bring-your-own-capacity storage financing shifting non-lithium LDES past lithium-ion on hyperscaler criteria (speed, cycle life) over lowest cost
leasehold vs freehold commercial property collateral risk under debt-deflation
right-of-first-refusal supplier lockups as the same logic across turbines and storage
comment: stories = every distinct item covered (short slugs); explainers = concepts actually explained, so future episodes won't re-explain them
